candidates.description: This feature vector represents common vowel signs, independent vowels, and phonetic suffixes used in the Devanagari script for Hindi and related languages.
This vector activates for the Hindi letter 'द' (da) and its various vowel-modified and conjunct forms.
This vector is related to Hindi vowel matras and common punctuation marks used in Indic script typography.
The vector represents common Hindi verb roots, suffixes, and inflectional morphemes.
This vector activates for common Hindi vowel signs, nasalization markers, and frequent sub-word suffixes.
This vector activates for common subwords, suffixes, and character combinations frequently found in Hindi text.
This vector represents numerical digits and integers.
The tokens represent numerical values that frequently appear in technical data, measurements, or indexing sequences.
This vector is related to numeric values, specifically three-digit integers.
This vector activates for mixed subword fragments and characters from multilingual and uppercase text.
